Please go ahead.","zh":"大家好。感谢各位参加 Amer Sports 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议。管理层准备发言结束后，我们将进入问答环节。如果您想提问，请按星号键 1 举手；如需撤回问题，请再次按星号键 1。现在我把会议交给投资者关系与资本市场负责人 Omar Saad。请继续。"},{"id":2,"startTime":27,"endTime":76,"speaker":"Omar Saad","speakerType":"management","en":"Welcome, everyone. Thanks for joining Amer Sports earnings call for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026. Earlier this morning, we announced our financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and the release can be found on our IR website, investors.amersports.com. A quick reminder to everyone that today's call will contain certain forward-looking statements within the meaning of the federal securities laws. These forward-looking statements reflect our current expectations and beliefs only. They are subject to certain risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Please see the safe harbor statement in our earnings release and SEC filings. We will also discuss certain non-IFRS financial measures. Please refer to our earnings release for important information regarding such non-IFRS financial measures, including reconciliations to the most comparable IFRS financial measures.","zh":"欢迎大家。感谢各位参加 Amer Sports 2026 财年第二季度财报电话会议。今天早些时候，我们公布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的财务业绩，业绩公告可在我们的投资者关系网站 investors.amersports.com 查阅。提醒大家，今天的电话会议将包含联邦证券法所定义的前瞻性陈述。这些陈述仅反映公司当前的预期和判断，并受到可能导致实际结果出现重大差异的风险和不确定性影响。具体内容请参阅业绩公告和 SEC 文件中的安全港声明。我们还将讨论若干非 IFRS 财务指标，包括与最具可比性的 IFRS 财务指标之间的调节，请参阅业绩公告了解相关重要信息。 我们还将讨论某些非 IFRS 财务指标。"},{"id":3,"startTime":76,"endTime":100,"speaker":"Omar Saad","speakerType":"management","en":"We will begin with prepared remarks from our CEO, James Zheng, and CFO, Andrew Page, followed by a Q&A session until 9:00 A.M. Eastern. James will cover key operational and brand highlights, then Andrew will provide a financial review at both the group and segment level, and also walk through our updated guidance. Arc'teryx CEO, Stuart Haselden, and Salomon CEO, Guillaume Meyzenq, will join for the Q&A session. With that, I will turn the call over to James.","zh":"会议将首先由首席执行官 James Zheng 和首席财务官 Andrew Page 进行准备发言，随后进入问答环节，持续至美国东部时间上午 9 点。James 将介绍主要运营和品牌亮点，Andrew 将从集团和细分市场两个层面进行财务回顾，并说明更新后的业绩指引。Arc’teryx 首席执行官 Stuart Haselden 和 Salomon 首席执行官 Guillaume Meyzenq 也将参加问答。下面把会议交给 James。"},{"id":4,"startTime":100,"endTime":173,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Thanks, Omar. Our global momentum continued in the second quarter, with over 30% revenue growth and a strong operating margin expansion. All segments, geographies, and channels achieved strong double-digit growth, led by another exceptional quarter from Salomon Softgoods, a strong Arc'teryx omnichannel, and a Wilson Tennis 360 acceleration. We manage a portfolio of sports and outdoor brands that is very unique in the marketplace. All three of our primary growth engines, Arc'teryx, Salomon Softgoods, and Wilson Tennis 360 are still relatively small, with significant room to grow. First, I will recap key highlights from our three segments. Starting with technical apparel. Arc'teryx delivered another great quarter with broad-based strengths across regions, channels, and categories, including another exceptional performance in women's. Strong DTC momentum also continued, driven by a 17% technical apparel omnichannel.","zh":"谢谢，Omar。首先，我来回顾三个细分市场的主要亮点，从技术服装业务开始。第二季度我们的全球业务势头延续，收入增长超过 30%，经营利润率也显著扩张。所有细分市场、地区和渠道都实现了强劲的两位数增长，Salomon Softgoods 再次表现出色，Arc’teryx 全渠道业务表现强劲，Wilson Tennis 360 也加速增长。我们管理着一个在市场上非常独特的运动和户外品牌组合。Arc’teryx、Salomon Softgoods 和 Wilson Tennis 360 这三大核心增长引擎目前规模仍相对较小，拥有很大的增长空间。Arc’teryx 再次交出出色季度业绩，各地区、渠道和品类均表现广泛向好，女装业务也再次表现突出。DTC 动能继续保持强劲，技术服装全渠道业务增长 17%。"},{"id":5,"startTime":173,"endTime":245,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We believe Arc'teryx is a truly global brand with significant runway in all major markets and are encouraged by the strong double-digit growth across all four regions in Q2. The brand also resonates strongly across categories and consumer segments. I want to highlight our momentum in women's, which grew faster than any other category for Arc'teryx. Our confidence in the size and the scale of our women's opportunity is very large. Brand awareness and affinity with women is rising significantly as we improve fit, style, and function, and also build expanded assortments. Redesigning our core ABCG models for her, plus expanding feminine color palettes, is driving higher female traffic and conversion. In Q2, newness and the seasonal colorways generate over 60% of women's sales. Standout new franchises include the Singiura and Oria lightweight hiking styles, and also the Sonii utility vest and jacket.","zh":"我们认为 Arc’teryx 是一个真正的全球品牌，在所有主要市场都拥有很长的增长空间。第二季度四大地区均实现强劲的两位数增长，这让我们备受鼓舞。品牌在不同品类和消费者群体中都具有很强的吸引力。我想重点说明女装业务的势头，它的增速超过 Arc’teryx 的其他任何品类。我们对女装业务机会的规模和潜力都非常有信心。随着我们改善合身度、风格和功能，并扩充产品组合，女性消费者对品牌的认知度和亲和力都在明显提升。为女性重新设计核心 ABCG 款式，并扩大女性色彩组合，正在带来更高的女性客流和转化率。第二季度，新品和季节性色彩占女装销售额的 60% 以上。表现突出的新产品系列包括轻量徒步款 Singiura 和 Oria，以及 Sonii 多功能马甲和夹克。"},{"id":6,"startTime":245,"endTime":316,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Our remarkable success in women's bottoms with franchises like the Krakja, Rutja, and Nia pants is helping us unlock the female consumer from head to toe, driving higher overall spend. Turning to footwear, which had another great quarter, including strong double-digit growth across regions, led by both existing and new styles. Popular existing styles included Norvan LD 4 trail shoe, which continues to be our biggest volume driver, followed by the Konseal trekking shoes. In March, we launched the latest version of our technical trail running shoe, the Sylan 2, performing very well so far. We are excited to have eight Arc'teryx trail run athletes competing in the UTMB race in Chamonix next week. Looking forward, we are confident that Arc'teryx has an exciting pipeline of shoe releases for the upcoming years. Turning to our Veilance sub-brand, which had a solid growth in Q2 on a small base.","zh":"Krakja、Rutja 和 Nia 裤装等产品系列在女装下装业务上的显著成功，正在帮助我们吸引从头到脚的女性消费者，并带动整体消费金额提升。再看鞋类业务，本季度也表现出色，各地区均实现强劲的两位数增长，既有现有款式，也有新品推动。热销的现有款式包括 Norvan LD 4 越野鞋，它继续是我们最大的销量驱动款，其次是 Konseal 徒步鞋。3 月，我们推出了技术型越野跑鞋 Sylan 2 的最新版本，目前表现非常好。我们很高兴下周在夏蒙尼举行的 UTMB 比赛中，将有 8 名 Arc’teryx 越野跑运动员参赛。展望未来，我们相信 Arc’teryx 未来几年将拥有令人期待的鞋类新品管线。再看 Veilance 子品牌，第二季度在较小基数上实现了稳健增长。"},{"id":7,"startTime":316,"endTime":394,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We continue to focus on investing newness, further developing our collections, and expanding distributions. All of which is creating engagement and awareness in the marketplace. Turning to sustainability and the ReBIRD, which continue to be at the heart of Arc'teryx. In Q2, we added five new ReBIRD centers, bringing us to 47 total. Later this month, we will unveil an important new innovation, which combines our passion for sustainability with uncompromised technical performance. Unmountain, our renowned Chamonix alpine academy, was again a great success in July with over 15,000 visitors in the village over the weekend and more than 1,000 attendees in clinics. Our Mountain Academies are the world's premium mountain education events and the space for mountain enthusiasts of all levels to advance their skills and the knowledge through clinics on the mountain. We are especially proud that women now account for half of the academy participants.","zh":"我们将继续投资于新品，进一步开发产品系列，并扩大分销覆盖，这些举措都在提升市场参与度和品牌认知度。下面谈谈可持续发展和 ReBIRD，它们仍然是 Arc’teryx 的核心。第二季度，我们新增了 5 个 ReBIRD 中心，使中心总数达到 47 个。本月底，我们将公布一项重要创新，将我们对可持续发展的热情与不妥协的技术性能结合起来。我们在夏蒙尼打造的知名高山学院 Unmountain 于 7 月再次取得成功，周末期间村镇接待访客超过 15,000 人，参加课程的学员超过 1,000 人。我们的山地学院是全球高端山地教育活动，为不同水平的山地爱好者提供在山地课程中提升技能和知识的平台。我们尤其自豪的是，女性目前占学院参与者的一半。"},{"id":8,"startTime":394,"endTime":466,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Turning to Peak Performance, which delivered solid growth in Q2. The brand continues to reduce its Nordic dependency and is rationalizing its footprint in the region while seeing healthy growth in other parts of EMEA. For both Peak Performance and our winter sports equipment brands, we are excited that Freeride Ski will become an Olympic sport at the 2030 Games. Peak Performance sponsored the Freeride World Tour, and our ski equipment brand sponsor many of the professional freeride skiers. Now, turning to the Outdoor Performance segment, which was led by another outstanding quarter from Salomon Softgoods. The investments we are making to grow Salomon brand awareness and the distribution footprint are paying off, driving strong footwear momentum across regions, channels, and for both sport style and the performance products. I'd like to highlight a few factors that give us the confidence that Salomon is well-positioned to achieve its long-term potential.","zh":"再看 Peak Performance，第二季度实现了稳健增长。该品牌继续降低对北欧地区的依赖，并在该地区优化业务布局，同时在欧洲、中东和非洲地区的其他市场实现健康增长。对于 Peak Performance 和我们的冬季运动装备品牌而言，令人振奋的是，自由式滑雪将成为 2030 年奥运会的正式项目。Peak Performance 赞助了自由式滑雪世界巡回赛，我们的滑雪装备品牌也赞助了许多职业自由式滑雪运动员。下面转向户外运动业务，该业务再次由 Salomon Softgoods 的出色季度表现带动。我们为提升 Salomon 品牌认知度和分销覆盖所进行的投资正在产生回报，推动鞋类业务在各地区、各渠道以及运动时尚和专业性能产品中保持强劲势头。下面我想说明几个让我们相信 Salomon 能够实现长期潜力的因素。"},{"id":9,"startTime":466,"endTime":537,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Number one, global sportstyle momentum continues. Sportstyle is critical to developing Salomon's position as the modern outdoor sneaker brand. The XT-6 and the XT-Whisper franchises are resonating with a younger and a more diverse audience from technical sports in the mountains to culture and the community in the cities. We were excited to announce that Jisoo, the global superstar singer and actress, will be Salomon's new global ambassador. The news had amazing global coverage, reaching nearly one billion consumers across social platforms. Second, our performance lines are also working well. We continue to believe our new gravel franchise is helping to unlock the run category for Salomon like never before. Salomon is gaining traction in the run specialty channels in North America and EMEA. In July, we launched the Aero Glide 4 with a re-engineering upper using new mesh technology.","zh":"第一，全球运动时尚势头仍在延续。运动时尚对于确立 Salomon 现代户外运动鞋品牌的定位至关重要。XT-6 和 XT-Whisper 产品系列正受到更年轻、更多元消费者的欢迎，覆盖从山地技术运动到城市文化与社区的场景。我们很高兴宣布，全球巨星歌手兼演员 Jisoo 将成为 Salomon 的新任全球品牌大使。这一消息在全球获得了极高曝光，在社交平台触达了近 10 亿消费者。第二，我们的专业性能产品线也运行良好。我们继续相信，新的 Gravel 产品系列正在以前所未有的方式帮助 Salomon 打开跑步品类。Salomon 正在北美和欧洲、中东及非洲的专业跑步渠道获得牵引力。7 月，我们推出了采用全新网眼技术、重新设计鞋面的 Aero Glide 4。"},{"id":10,"startTime":537,"endTime":608,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We also recently launched the second generation of Genesis, a highly technical trail shoe. Salomon athletes were winning races in Q2, including Courtney Dauwalter earning her fourth Hardrock 100 title, validating Salomon's technical merit on the hardest trails. Third, Salomon continued to have excellent brand heat in Greater China and Asia, where we believe we operate the most productive and profitable sneaker shops in the industry. Greater China continued to deliver very strong double-digit growth in Q2, driven by strength across sportstyles, performance, and apparel. Our local for local apparel and accessories lines in China with technical products inspired by outdoor and trail running has also been gained traction the past few quarters. Beyond China, Salomon is also experiencing surging demands in Korea and Japan, very important markets, given their influence on global sneaker culture. Fourth, our epicenter strategy is working.","zh":"我们最近还推出了第二代 Genesis，这是一款技术含量很高的越野鞋。Salomon 运动员在第二季度不断赢得比赛，其中 Courtney Dauwalter 第四次赢得 Hardrock 100 冠军，验证了 Salomon 在最艰难越野赛道上的技术实力。第三，Salomon 在大中华区和亚洲继续保持很高的品牌热度，我们认为自己在这里运营着行业内生产效率和盈利能力最高的运动鞋门店。第二季度大中华区继续实现非常强劲的两位数增长，运动时尚、专业性能和服装业务均表现良好。我们在中国推出的本地化服装和配饰产品线，采用受户外运动和越野跑启发的技术产品，过去几个季度也逐渐获得市场牵引力。在中国之外，Salomon 在韩国和日本也面临需求快速上升的趋势，这两个市场对于全球运动鞋文化具有重要影响。第四，我们的核心城市策略正在奏效。"},{"id":11,"startTime":608,"endTime":676,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Focusing on key global metro markets is allowing us to build up Salomon's reach and presence in the right way. Our Tier 1 global epicenter, Paris, London, Shanghai, Beijing, Tokyo, New York, and Los Angeles, are all driving very strong sales momentum as well as rising brand awareness. We approach these markets by opening a handful of impactful brand stores in the most relevant locations alongside handpicked elevated wholesale doors. In these markets, we also invest in event partnerships, community activations, and the local media to build a strong and lasting connection with our consumers. We plan to adopt and expand this approach to several new major cities in the future, including Berlin, Seoul, Miami, San Francisco, Chicago, and Boston. Fifth is the strong demand we are experiencing in our home market, Europe, driving strong reorders, pre-orders, and sales through.","zh":"聚焦全球主要都市市场，正在帮助我们以正确的方式扩大 Salomon 的覆盖和影响力。巴黎、伦敦、上海、北京、东京、纽约和洛杉矶这些一级核心城市，都在带来非常强劲的销售势头和不断提升的品牌认知度。我们在这些市场选择最相关的位置开设少量具有影响力的品牌门店，并配合精心挑选的高端批发销售点。在这些市场，我们还投资于活动合作、社区活动和本地媒体，以便与消费者建立牢固且持久的联系。未来，我们计划把这一方法推广到更多主要城市，包括柏林、首尔、迈阿密、旧金山、芝加哥和波士顿。第五，我们在本土市场欧洲感受到的需求很强，推动了强劲的补单、预售和终端销售。"},{"id":12,"startTime":676,"endTime":739,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Sportstyle continues to be the biggest growth driver, but gravel is also impacting in Europe, supported by marketing campaigns, in-store events, and the running event activations. We are seeing high e-com growth in Europe, even as we expand our premium DTC and wholesale footprint. In markets, we have been very active hosting a gravel-focused running event called the Gravelander, sponsoring music festivals and artist collaborations. Most recently, we began a unique partnership with the Opéra national de Paris to outfit their dancers. Lastly, I will mention the U.S., which is the largest single sneaker market in the world, but still a small business for us. We know there's a strong demand for Salomon here, but still very limited distribution for consumers to find us.","zh":"运动时尚仍然是最大的增长驱动因素，但 Gravel 在欧洲也开始产生明显影响，这得益于营销活动、门店活动和跑步赛事激活。即使我们扩大高端 DTC 和批发覆盖，欧洲电商仍然保持较高增长。在欧洲市场，我们积极举办以 Gravel 为主题的跑步活动 Gravelander，赞助音乐节并开展艺术家合作。最近，我们还开始与巴黎国家歌剧院开展独特合作，为其舞者提供装备。最后谈谈美国。美国是全球最大的单一运动鞋市场，但对我们而言仍然是一个规模较小的业务。我们知道美国市场对 Salomon 有很强需求，但消费者能够找到我们产品的分销覆盖仍然非常有限。"},{"id":13,"startTime":739,"endTime":800,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Today, we are seeing a clear acceleration in North America as we leverage the rising brand awareness to expand its distribution with both new and existing wholesale partners, as well as our own stores and e-com. In Q2, we opened our first North America flagship stores on Fifth Avenue in the Flatiron District of New York City, offering both footwear and apparel. We continue to carefully expand our footprint and shelf space in existing wholesale partners, including Nordstrom, JD Sports, and Foot Locker. Lastly, before I switch to ball and racket, although Q2 is a very small quarter for our winter sports equipment franchise, Salomon, Atomic, and Armada, we are pleased that our brands continuing taking share despite challenging conditions in certain markets. Moving to ball and racket highlights.","zh":"如今，随着品牌认知度提升，我们正在扩大 Salomon 在北美的分销，与新的和现有的批发伙伴合作，同时发展自营门店和电商。第二季度，我们在纽约市 Flatiron 区的第五大道开设了北美首家旗舰店，同时销售鞋类和服装。我们继续谨慎扩大现有批发合作伙伴中的门店覆盖和陈列空间，包括 Nordstrom、JD Sports 和 Foot Locker。最后，在转向球类与球拍业务之前，尽管第二季度对于 Salomon、Atomic 和 Armada 这些冬季运动装备品牌而言是全年很小的季度，但即使部分市场条件充满挑战，我们仍然很高兴看到这些品牌继续提升市场份额。下面转向球类与球拍业务的亮点。"},{"id":14,"startTime":800,"endTime":868,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"Ball and racket sales grew 24% in Q2, driven by continued strength in Tennis 360, both softgoods and rackets, as well as improved growth in baseball, golf, and inflatables. Our Tennis 360 strategy continues to resonate very well with consumers, from unique lines of tennis apparel and footwear to high-performance rackets. Wilson had a couple very big racket launches this spring, including a Q1 rollout of our iconic Blade franchise, version 10. This has been one of the strongest launches in our history and also the rackets for world number one Aryna Sabalenka. We also recently launched a completely new racket line called the Defy. This is our first ever power spin racket, which has been a growing segment of the racket market. Early results from the Defy are even exceeding the Blade v10 launch I just mentioned.","zh":"第二季度球类与球拍业务销售额增长 24%，主要由 Tennis 360 持续强劲的表现推动，软商品和球拍均有贡献；棒球、高尔夫和充气产品的增长也有所改善。我们的 Tennis 360 战略继续得到消费者认可，产品覆盖独特的网球服装和鞋类，以及高性能球拍。Wilson 今年春季推出了几款重要球拍，包括第一季度推出的标志性 Blade 产品系列第 10 代。这是我们历史上最强劲的新品发布之一，世界排名第一的 Aryna Sabalenka 也使用了这款球拍。我们最近还推出了全新的 Defy 球拍系列，这是我们首款主打力量和旋转的球拍，所处的细分市场正在增长。Defy 的早期表现甚至超过了刚才提到的 Blade v10 发布表现。"},{"id":15,"startTime":868,"endTime":939,"speaker":"James Zheng","speakerType":"management","en":"We continue to invest in new tour players, recently signing former world top five player Holger Rune, and the 17-year-old rising star Moïse Kouamé, both playing the Defy racket. Markéta Vondroušová, one of our highest profile head-to-toe athletes, has been creating great buzz for the brand with her unique Wilson Tennis outfits, reaching the semifinals at both Roland-Garros and Wimbledon. Wilson softgoods continue its exceptional trajectories with very strong growth across all four major regions. Also, baseball, golf, and inflatables saw improved growth in the quarter. Before turning it over to Andrew, I'd like to conclude by saying that given the broad-based momentum across our portfolio, a healthy and a growing premium sports and outdoor markets, and the world-class teams we have in place around the world, I'm very confident in the future outlook for Amer Sports.
